channel.title: OpenAI Research & Releases
channel.description: Latest research papers and model releases from OpenAI

item.title: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
item.description: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

item.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
item.description: Manage your business information, get insights about how your business shows up, and turn interest into action in ChatGPT.

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

item.title: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
item.description: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
item.description: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

item.title: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
item.description: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

item.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
item.description: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

item.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
item.description: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

item.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
item.description: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

item.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
item.description: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

item.title: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
item.description: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

item.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
item.description: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

item.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
item.description: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

item.title: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
item.description: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

item.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
item.description: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

item.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
item.description: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is developing AI workflows to help portfolio managers compare research views and examine investment risks.

item.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
item.description: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

item.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
item.description: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

item.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
item.description: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

item.title: Introducing Images 2.6
item.description: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.
